validation_behavior_findings.statement: The public dataset manifest binds HAI 23.05, ten approved local-only files, one-second nominal sampling, 86 global point columns, four process IDs, and external test-label roles.
P1 is a frozen Boiler process scope; the variable-role universe is 12 approved sources by 12 process-sensor targets with sorted identities and 144 directed pairs.
The candidate and profiling loaders exclude timestamps and labels from numeric feature matrices and fail on absent or nonfinite selected values.
D0 test1 enforces exact 37-P1 source order, 54000-row closure, float64 finiteness, and unique timestamp tokens; D1 separately enforces its canonical 22-feature union and strict decimal tokens.
D0 and D1 labels are separate exact timestamp,label CSVs and must align to the already parsed feature timestamp sequence.

The generic SplitManifestV2 and assert_operation_permitted_v2 contracts are robust foundation guards, but direct invocation by every frozen task bridge is not established; several executions use independent task-specific IDs and guards.

The provenance structural audit records empty/malformed/inconsistent counts but its dataclass alone does not require all counts to be zero; authoritative downstream construction and task-specific loaders add further fail-closed checks.
No imputation or clipping path exists in the inspected frozen test loaders; missing or malformed numeric tokens fail closed.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.documented_or_surface_behavior: DatasetFileV2 marks test_time_series label_availability as available.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: Feature CSVs and label CSVs are distinct physical roles; the feature loaders do not consume a label column.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: A reader can mistake availability in the dataset edition for an inline feature-file label.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: Document label_availability as dataset-pair availability, not inline-column presence.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.documented_or_surface_behavior: The generic split permission API appears to govern all v6 operations.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: Frozen candidate, profiling, D0, and D1 paths also implement task-specific file, hash, state, and token guards; direct assert_operation_permitted_v2 calls are not universal.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: Reviewers may overstate a single centralized enforcement point.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: ARCH-001 should map generic freeze-time governance and task-specific execution guards as two explicit layers.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.documented_or_surface_behavior: load_authorized_numeric_segments_v1 sounds self-sufficient for complete file identity custody.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: It gates process/files/features and finite values, while exact file/header identity is verified by its execution caller before value loading.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: Calling the loader outside the frozen runner could omit full identity checks.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: Deep GDN review should treat the runner plus loader as the authority unit.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.documented_or_surface_behavior: One P1 feature schema may be assumed throughout the pipeline.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: Distinct justified schemas coexist: 37 D0/GDN features, 24 relation-fit columns, 12x12 role identities, and 22 D1 evaluator features.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: Counts or order hashes can be compared across incompatible roles.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: Dashboard/report should label every count with its consumer and purpose.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: D1 uses strict ASCII decimal tokens; D0 and relation/GDN loaders use Python float conversion followed by finiteness checks.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: Equivalent valid-token language is not proven, although frozen source bytes remove observed ambiguity.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: Record parser semantics in ARCH-007/008; do not change frozen code here.

contract_mismatches_and_gaps.documented_or_surface_behavior: Manifest-level timestamp format validation can be read as occurring in every execution loader.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.actual_contract: Provenance audits parse timestamps; D0/D1 runtime feature loaders require uniqueness and later exact label alignment but do not reparse the timestamp format.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.risk: Runtime relies on frozen file identity plus provenance for timestamp syntax.
contract_mismatches_and_gaps.recommended_action: Describe this as compositional custody, not a missing scientific check.

coordinator_handoff.verdict: Use as input-contract and function-catalog evidence; cross-check train4 execution status and universal split-guard equivalence with Agents B/D.
top_points: Do not conflate 86 global points, 37 D0/GDN features, 24 profiling columns, 12x12 candidate identities, and 22 D1 evaluator features.
Represent label availability as external paired custody, not an inline feature column.
Represent split governance as generic manifest/operation contracts plus task-specific execution guards.
Preserve the frozen runner plus GDN numeric loader as a compositional authority unit.
Timestamp format is audited at provenance time; frozen D0/D1 runtime relies on byte identity, uniqueness, and label alignment.
